description: For a wallet that already holds the assets it brings; from ETH or USDG, plan_build does the whole thing in one transaction. A ladder is one deposit spread over up to 40 narrow one-sided ranges ('rungs') of a Uniswap v3 or v4 pool: rungs under the price hold the quote asset (ETH, WETH, USDG or LOOM) and buy the token as it falls, rungs over the price hold the token and sell it as it rises, and rungs the price trades through earn the pool's swap fee. Give the band as percent from the current price (lowPct negative for under the price), the amounts as decimal strings, and the owner wallet. With one asset only, `split: true` swaps part of it for the other in the same pool and builds the whole band in one transaction (the minimum out comes from the chain's quoter, hook taxes included). Returns the unsigned transactions (approvals if needed, then the open or the zap) laid out from the pool's price on the chain right now, simulated in order from the owner (check) and each with a gas limit. You sign and send them from the owner wallet, at once; nothing is signed or sent here. Fees: 0.25% of what goes in, taken out of the rungs as they are minted (0.1% of it to `referrer` when given, 0.1% to the owner of the ladder `copyOf` names while it is open in the same pair); then 5% of the trading fees the ladder earns, nothing of a gain when liquidity is taken out, and 5% of the ladder's value when the NFTs are taken out instead; 3.5% for an owner holding 100,000 LOOM. Every cut is paid as USDG, with a slice of the token sold in the same pool when the money side is short.

copyOf.description: The id of a ladder on the current contract this one copies: its owner is paid 0.1% while it is open in the same pair.

fullRange.description: One position across every price instead of a band of rungs. Never out of range and needs no watching; very little of the money sits at the price, so it earns the least per dollar. Needs both amounts, or one amount with split: true. lowPct and highPct are ignored.

newPool.description: From plan_open_pool's `then`, for a pool being opened in the same plan: the ladder is laid out against its key and opening price. No split in it (it is empty): both amounts, or one for a one-sided ladder.

payWithEth.description: For a pool quoted in WETH: pay in plain ETH, wrapped inside the same transaction, with nothing to approve. Default: whenever the wallet holds less WETH than amountQuote.

pool.description: A pool from ladder_pools; the default pool when left out

referrer.description: The wallet that referred the owner: paid 0.1% of what goes in, out of the opening fee, and kept by the contract from the owner's first ladder on.

slippagePct.description: Left out: 2% on a calm pool, more on one whose price has been moving (set from its last fifteen minutes, at most 10%)
